LanguageData.AE_TT_DefaultSortMode: Configures how the "Auto Tier Tag" reorders the colonist bar after applying tier prefix. None: only apply prefix, keep original order. By Tier+Skill: S->A->B->C->D->X left to right, within tier by core skill level sum desc (recommended). By Role+Tier: Front -> Shooter -> Worker -> Trade -> Other, within role by tier desc. Note: when "group colonist bar by role" is enabled this setting is ignored; rating always reorders by role groups to keep them contiguous.
LanguageData.AE_TT_GroupByRole: Split colonist bar portraits into five role groups (Front/Shooter/Worker/Trade/Other). Pawns inside a group frame can be reordered together. When enabled, the bar is automatically sorted by Role+Tier; when disabled, vanilla map/caravan grouping is restored. The checkboxes below are the only criteria: a colonist is grouped only when a checked condition matches.
LanguageData.AE_ReallocRules_CustomTier_Desc: Manually assign a tier for this colonist, bypassing auto formula. In DEBUG mode the label shows the code (e.g. S#John).
LanguageData.AE_Tier_SSS: SSS: TriggerHappy+Tough+Shooting Major / Tough+Melee Major+Nimble/Brawler / Industrious+Neurotic+3 work Majors
LanguageData.AE_Tier_SS: SS: TriggerHappy+Shooting Major / Tough+Melee Major / Industrious+Neurotic+2 work Majors
LanguageData.AE_Tier_S: S: TriggerHappy+Shooting Minor / Tough+Melee passion / Industrious+Neurotic+1 work Major / Special talent / Beauty+Social Major
LanguageData.AE_Tier_D: D: demoted one tier if has negative trait (Pyromaniac/SlowLearner/Wimp/Industriousness -1/-2) and original tier > D
LanguageData.AE_Tier_X: X: violent work disabled (pacifist etc., determined before other tiers)
LanguageData.AE_GhoulHint: Ghouls cannot use gear. Tier shown for player reference only.
LanguageData.AE_TT_Role_Default: Default: no significant combat skill tendency
LanguageData.AE_TT_Role_Shooter: Shooter: Shooting>=8 and Shooting>Melee, prefers ranged weapons
LanguageData.AE_TT_Role_Brawler: Brawler: Melee>=8 or Brawler trait, prefers melee (Veto ranged)
LanguageData.AE_TT_Role_Doctor: Doctor: Medicine>=8 and is highest combat-related skill
LanguageData.AE_TT_Role_Worker: Worker: Shooting and Melee both <5, prefers work-stat apparel
LanguageData.AE_TT_Role_Leader: Ideo Leader: has ideology role (label only)
LanguageData.AE_TT_Context_Idle: Idle: ghoul does not participate in context detection
LanguageData.AE_TT_Context_Cold: Cold: ambient temp below comfort range for 2500 ticks
LanguageData.AE_TT_Context_Hot: Hot: ambient temp above comfort range for 2500 ticks
LanguageData.AE_TT_Tier: Tier S/A/B/C/D/X determined by passion and trait combinations, decides colonist bar sort priority
LanguageData.AE_TT_ArmorPref_Heavy: Heavy[front]: prefers heavy armor to absorb frontline damage (display only, no auto-allocation)
LanguageData.AE_TT_ArmorPref_Flexible: Flex[back]: free choice by score (display only, no auto-allocation)
LanguageData.AE_TT_ArmorPref_Light: Light[worker]: prefers light armor for work efficiency (display only, no auto-allocation)
LanguageData.AE_TT_GlobalWorkReallocate: Reassign all colonists' (incl. slaves) work priorities via multi-pass coordinated allocation by work category. Emergency (firefighting/patient/bedrest)=1; key work (Doctor/Warden/Childcare/Cooking/PlantCutting) passionate top2=1 and guarantee ≥2; other skill work (Construction/Mining/Growing/Smithing/Tailoring/Crafting/Art) passionate top2=2 and guarantee ≥2; secondary work (Handling/Fishing/Hunting) passionate top2=2 and guarantee ≥2 (Hunting requires ranged weapon + back row first); Research guarantee 1; service work (Hauling/Cleaning) by tier S+=4 / A/B/C=3 / D/X=1 (researcher hauling downgraded to 4 to avoid interrupting research). Sorted by passion→skill→workCount 3-factor, skill ≥12 floor priority=2, ≥8 floor priority=3.
LanguageData.AE_TT_AutoTierTag: When checked, auto-executes tier tagging: every 3000 ticks, and immediately on new colonist. Executes once immediately when checked; when unchecked, clears all tier tags and restores original names.
LanguageData.AE_TT_AutoWorkConfig: When checked, auto-executes work reallocation: marks pending on colonist count change, executes when 2500 tick cooldown elapses AND no combat on map; fires immediately on new colonist. Executes once immediately when checked; when unchecked, only stops auto-execution, keeps current work assignment.
LanguageData.AE_TT_AutoMarkPawn: When checked, draws a high-value marker above humanlike pawns of S+ tier (S/SS/SSS) within the scan scope (see "Scan non-player factions only" below). Color by category: Colonist=Gold, Slave=Orange, Prisoner=Yellow, Enemy=Red, Neutral/Ally=Cyan, Wild=White. For quick identification of high-value targets to prioritize capture, recruitment or vigilance. Toggling the checkbox triggers a global rescan and pops a message listing all current high-value targets; while checked, when map personnel increase, auto-scans new pawns and pops a message when new high-value targets are discovered. Does not modify any object name, pure frontend drawing, safe and reversible, no save side effects; when unchecked, the star disappears automatically.
LanguageData.AE_AutoMarkPawn_FullScan: Scanned all pawns, found {0} high-value targets (S+ tier):
LanguageData.AE_AutoCarry_SkippedInCombat: Auto carry paused during combat, retry after combat ends
LanguageData.AE_TT_AutoCarry: When checked, colonists auto-carry food, drugs and enhancement serums per the per-item settings below; 0 means do not carry. Scans inventory every 6000 ticks (~100s, adjustable) and dispatches haul jobs for missing items; paused during combat to avoid leaving positions; skips colonists in surgery/recovery. Food is controlled by total amount, preferring packaged meals/pemmican; non-sleeping pawns skip Wake-Up; ghouls and mechanoids excluded. Actual drug amounts are limited by the drug policy "take" column; enabling "Drug Policy" syncs these amounts automatically. Executes once immediately when checked; when unchecked, only stops auto-execution, keeps current inventory.
LanguageData.AE_TT_AutoDrugPolicy: When checked, auto-creates 3 drug policies and assigns by tier: - AE-S (S/SS/SSS): social drugs (beer+smokeleaf+psychite tea) + Wake-Up1 + Go-Juice1 + Penoxycyline1; Juggernaut + Metalblood serums carried by AutoCarry module - AE-AB (A/B): same as AE-S - AE-CDX (C/D/X): social drugs + Wake-Up1 (Luciferium not carried, Go-Juice/Penoxycyline only for AB/S tiers) Base config: beer+smokeleaf+psychite tea (allowedForJoy=true, allowedForAddiction=true). Scheduled use (allowScheduled) only for psychite tea (every 2 days) and Penoxycyline (AB/S, every 5 days). Luciferium: no carry, no scheduled (addiction only). Wake-Up: no scheduled, carry 1. Go-Juice: AB/S carry 1. Reassigns every 3000 ticks and on colonist count change. Existing policies with same name are refilled to ensure latest preset takes effect. When unchecked, only stops auto-execution, assigned policies remain.
LanguageData.AE_CFG_MasterDisabled: Auto Everything is disabled: all automation is paused (enable it in General).
LanguageData.AE_CFG_TierRuleBasis: Tier basis: S = Workaholic or Neurotic (both degree 2) + at least 1 professional major; SS = both traits combined; SSS = combo + professional majors ≥ 3 (slider adjustable).
LanguageData.AE_CFG_TierRuleBasisNote: Only degree-2 Workaholic/Neurotic count; Industrious and Nervous are ignored. Higher conditions override lower ones within a dimension; the three dimensions take the highest tier and never stack.
LanguageData.AE_CFG_TierRulePassionNote: Single/double = one/two passion flames. Professional work = Crafting/Construction/Artistic/Cooking/Plants/Mining.
LanguageData.AE_CFG_TierTableHint: Checked rules take part in evaluation; the slider only bounds the professional-major count for SSS. Changes clear the rating cache immediately.
LanguageData.AE_CFG_WorkRulesHint: Skill floor: when the related skill reaches a threshold, its work priority never drops below the floor value. Core works are those at priority 1/2.
LanguageData.AE_CFG_MarkRulesHint: Pawns reaching the threshold show a tier badge in the colonist bar or above their head; the tier also sets the minimum rating for carrying serum.
LanguageData.AE_CFG_CarryDrugHint: 0 means do not carry. Actual drug amounts are also limited by the drug policy "take" column: enabling "Drug Policy" syncs these amounts into the AE-* policies; otherwise the smaller of the two is carried so items are not dropped.
LanguageData.AE_CFG_GeneralHint: Rule changes take effect immediately (tier cache is cleared) and are saved automatically.
LanguageData.AE_TT_Enabled: Master switch: when off, work, tier, marking, carrying and drug policies are all paused.
LanguageData.AE_TT_TierAMajorMin: Minimum number of double passions required for tier A.
LanguageData.AE_TT_TierAPassionTotal: Minimum total of double plus single passions required for tier A.
LanguageData.AE_TT_TierBMajorMin: Minimum number of double passions required for tier B.
LanguageData.AE_TT_TierBPassionTotal: Minimum total of double plus single passions required for tier B.
LanguageData.AE_TT_TierRuleCell: Rule switch: when unchecked this combination no longer participates in evaluation; other rules are unaffected.
LanguageData.AE_TT_TierCol_TriggerHappy: Trigger-happy: −1 shooting accuracy, faster but less accurate fire; combines with Shooting passion to judge ranged value.
LanguageData.AE_TT_TierCol_ToughMelee: Tough: reduces incoming damage; combines with Melee passion and Nimble/Brawler to judge frontliner value.
LanguageData.AE_TT_TierCol_Workaholic: Workaholic = Industriousness degree 2; Neurotic = Neurotic degree 2. S needs either trait + a professional major; SS needs both traits combined.
LanguageData.AE_TT_TierRuleWorkMajors: Professional-work double passions (Crafting/Construction/Artistic/Cooking/Plants/Mining) needed to upgrade the SSS combo.
LanguageData.AE_TT_SpecialTalentToS: Pawns with one of the special talents, or with the unnatural healing / transmute steel ability, are rated S directly.
LanguageData.AE_TT_BeautySocialToS: Pawns with Beautiful (beauty level 2) and a double Social passion are rated S directly.
LanguageData.AE_TT_SpouseExemption: When the spouse reaches the selected tier, this pawn is rated at least that tier.
LanguageData.AE_TT_SpouseExemptionTier: Minimum spouse tier required to trigger the exemption.
LanguageData.AE_TT_MaxCoreWorkCount: Maximum number of high-priority (1/2) works per pawn; extra works keep only the floor priority.
LanguageData.AE_TT_SkillFloor: When the related skill reaches a threshold, priority stays at or above the floor value (high → 3, mid → 2).
LanguageData.AE_TT_ResearchDowngrade: While researching, hauling/cleaning drops to priority 4 so research is not interrupted.
LanguageData.AE_TT_WorkInterval: Interval of automatic work reallocation. Shorter is more responsive but costs more CPU.
LanguageData.AE_TT_SkipInCombat: Pause work reallocation and auto carry during combat (drafted or fighting) to avoid interrupting treatment or leaving posts.
LanguageData.AE_TT_MarkNotify: Show a message when new high-value pawns are found.
LanguageData.AE_TT_MarkIncludeNonPlayer: When checked, only non-player factions (hostile/neutral/ally/wild humans) are scanned and marked; when off, only player-faction pawns (colonists/slaves/prisoners) are scanned and marked.
LanguageData.AE_TT_MarkTier: Pawns at or above this tier are treated as high value; it also sets the minimum tier for serum carrying.
LanguageData.AE_TT_CarryFoodCount: Total food carried per colonist (summed across food types); concrete food is chosen by priority: packaged meal → pemmican → lavish → fine → simple → nutrient paste. 0 disables food carrying.
LanguageData.AE_TT_CarrySerumHighValueOnly: When checked, only units reaching the high-value tier threshold (configured on the High-value tab) carry serums; uncheck to let all eligible colonists carry them. With "Drug Policy" enabled, the S-tier gate still applies (the policy "take" column is 0 below S).
LanguageData.AE_TT_CarryItemCount: Drag to 0 to disable. Also keep the drug policy "take" column at least this high. With "Drug Policy" enabled, colonists below the item's tier gate (GoJuice/Penoxycyline: A; serums: S) do not carry it.
LanguageData.AE_TT_ResetCarryItems: Restore drug and serum amounts to defaults (total food and carry interval are unchanged).
LanguageData.AE_CFG_RoleGroup_ForceHint: Pure whitelist: a colonist is grouped only when a checked condition matches. Anything not matching a checked condition goes to "Other"; no skill/passion inference.
LanguageData.AE_CFG_RoleGroup_MovedHint: All role grouping conditions now live in the Group & Mark tab. Configure them there.
LanguageData.AE_TT_ScarBars: Draws amber bars at the portrait's bottom-right corner: 1 bar = 1 healed scar or truly missing body part (parts replaced by bionics/prosthetics do not count), capped at 3 bars; multiple scars on the same body part count once. Bars are as tall as the bond heart and vertically centered with it, laid out left-to-right starting right of the heart, sitting above vanilla status/role icons.
LanguageData.AE_BondPartner: Psychic bonded partner: {0} (same color and style of heart = same couple)
LanguageData.AE_CFG_RoleIconRules_Hint: Whitelist: the icon shows when any checked condition is met. When role grouping is on, shooter/worker/trader are already labelled by the group frame, so only the Tough icon remains. Changes apply immediately.
LanguageData.AE_TT_RoleIconToggle: The left checkbox controls whether the icon is drawn; the condition checkboxes decide which colonists trigger it.
LanguageData.AE_TT_Front_Brawler: Colonists with the Brawler trait are put in Front.
LanguageData.AE_TT_Front_MeleeSpecialist: Colonists holding the melee specialist ideoligion role are put in Front.
LanguageData.AE_TT_Shooter_Specialist: Colonists holding the shooting specialist ideoligion role are put in Shooter.
LanguageData.AE_TT_Shooter_TriggerHappy: Colonists with the trigger-happy trait are put in Shooter.
LanguageData.AE_TT_Worker_Pacifist: Colonists unable to do violent work (pacifists, violence-prohibiting ideoligion) are put in Worker. Checked after Trade rules, so moralists, beauty and social passion colonists keep their Trade group.
LanguageData.AE_TT_Worker_ProductionSpecialist: Colonists holding the production specialist ideoligion role are put in Worker.
LanguageData.AE_TT_Worker_Industrious: Colonists with the industrious trait (Industrious or Very industrious) are put in Worker.
LanguageData.AE_TT_Worker_Neurotic: Colonists with the neurotic trait (Neurotic or Very neurotic) are put in Worker.
LanguageData.AE_TT_Worker_CraftingMajor: Colonists with a major passion in Crafting are put in Worker.
LanguageData.AE_TT_Trade_Moralist: Colonists holding the moralist ideoligion role are put in Trade.
LanguageData.AE_TT_Trade_Beauty: Colonists with the Pretty or Beautiful trait are put in Trade.
LanguageData.AE_TT_Trade_SocialMajor: Colonists with a major passion in Social are put in Trade.
LanguageData.AE_CFG_RoleGroupRule_Order: Group display order (top → bottom = left to right on the colonist bar): Front → Shooter → Worker → Trade → Other; "Other" is always last
LanguageData.AE_CFG_RoleGroupRule_Other: • Other: colonists matching no checked condition (unchecking one condition only sends its matches here).
LanguageData.AE_CFG_RoleGroupRule_Drag: • To reorder: use the Up/Down buttons below, or right-drag a group's top header band or border onto another group. Colonists are re-grouped in the new order.
LanguageData.AE_CFG_RoleGroupOrder_Title: Group display order (top → bottom = left to right on the colonist bar)
LanguageData.AE_TT_RoleGroupOrder: Use Up/Down to reorder groups; you can also right-drag a group's top header band on the colonist bar. "Other" is always last and cannot be moved.
LanguageData.AE_TT_DragGroupOrder: Right-drag this header band onto another group to reorder groups
